## Summary

I implemented the OpenAPI sync merge/compare helpers in `packages/bruno-electron/src/ipc/openapi-sync.js` and exposed them via a `_test` module export.

### New functions added
- **`maskJsonInterpolations(jsonString)`** — walks the string tracking string/escape state, replacing bare `{{var}}` interpolations (values *and* keys) with quoted sentinels while leaving in-string variables and backslash-escaped content (Windows paths, escaped quotes) intact. Returns `{ masked, vars }`. Sentinels embed a per-call random nonce (`crypto.randomBytes`) so literal content resembling a sentinel is never corrupted.
- **`unmaskJsonInterpolations(maskedString, vars)`** — structurally matches sentinels and restores them by index, so bare-value vars come back unquoted and in-string vars stay quoted.
- **`mergeJsonValues(userObj, specObj, preserveValues)`** — recursive object/array merge per the spec (user wins on shared keys, spec-only added, user-only dropped, array shape-templating, primitive arrays kept, empty user array → `[spec[0]]`).
- **`mergeJsonBody`** — masks/parses both bodies (with distinct nonces to avoid sentinel collisions), merges, re-serializes, restores vars; returns spec ref when `preserveValues=false`, user body verbatim when user JSON is unparseable.
- **`mergeFieldListPreserving`** — spec-ordered merge by name with positional duplicate pairing, preserving user value/enabled (with spec `enabled` fallback) and file value arrays.
- **`mergeAuth`** — mode-gated defensive-clone merge (user wins, spec-introduced added, user-only kept); returns spec on mode mismatch / null user sub-object / `preserveValues=false`.
- **`mergeBody`** — dispatches by mode (json → `mergeJsonBody`, formUrlEncoded → field merge, graphql → clone of `user.graphql` else `spec.graphql`, xml/text/raw → user verbatim, mode mismatch → spec).

### Existing functions updated
- **`mergeSpecIntoRequest(existing, specItem, options={})`** — reworked to `{ preserveValues, fullReset }`. Sync mode: URL always from spec; body/params/headers/auth merged via the helpers; script/tests/assertions always preserved. `fullReset`: body/auth/method from spec, script/tests/assertions still preserved. Backward-compatible with existing IPC callers.
- **`compareRequestFields`** — removed auth *config* diffing (same auth mode ⇒ no diff regardless of config values) and the auth change label is now the string `'auth'` when modes differ.

I removed the now-unused `mergeWithUserValues` helper. No test files were touched. All behavior was verified with ~65 assertions covering each contract point.
